title: An Economic Constitution of Possibility: Producing Real Freedom, Bounding Contribution Claims, and Revocable Public Power

additional_titles.title: 可能性的经济宪法：真实自由的生产、贡献受领上界与可撤公共权力

description:
Modern economic orders confront three entangled structural dilemmas: nominal income or formal freedom of contract routinely coexists with substantive inability to leave a role; legitimate compensation for exploration, uncertainty-bearing, waiting, and maintenance repeatedly mutates through transfer and rollover into permanent private rule over others' futures; and public coordination oscillates between unaccountable sovereign offices and panoptic surveillance of private life. This paper formulates and proves an economic constitution for an era of rapidly generated possibilities. Its normative core separates basic participation standing, recognized contribution claims, scarce-resource requests, and revocable governance authority into four independently justified constitutional entitlements barred from cross-category promotion, while replacing panoptic worthiness testing with proof-carrying power: any institution spending common budgets or constraining others' feasible actions must carry verifiable proof of non-overreach, non-displacement of unsettled duties, and zero leakage of private reserves.

The paper gives eighteen formal results with counterexamples in rooted, provenance-preserving ledger models. Theorem 1.2 synthesizes the domain-specific constructions. The Lean proofs of regeneration join six conditions on each actual payment. First, real exit capacity equals maximum matching cardinality across a five-gate bipartite graph; dropping non-capture, payment linkage, or service routing yields three distinct institutional failures with identical scalar value K = 0 (the Three Zeros), equal positive capacity K = 1 can still conceal missing health provision (the Two Ones), under whole-domain coarse readout (0, ∅) the 2 × 2 diagonal repair matrix forces every post-processing rule to misdiagnose at least one failure branch, original exit demand obeys exact conservation K + Dmax⁽ᵒʳⁱᵍ⁾ = |Cact| (recording 100% of demand as deficit under full capture while keeping capacity and deficit invariant under mere price re-quoting), and the outside-role lifecycle both excludes four retaliation retypings and classifies reappearing former actors as same-debt successors rather than debt-free births (Theorems 2.1–2.2, Proposition 2.3, Theorem 3.1). Second, an open-event innovation law adjudicates two rounds of out-of-menu paid discovery under a mandatory current-living renewal gate (Theorem 4.1); unique issuance provenance bounds cumulative receipts across all slots, transfers, and stages by 0 ≤ Ro(r) ≤ Qo, ruling out unbounded extraction sequences, while eliminating asymmetric private port exclusion characterizes five-facet absence of capital (Theorem 4.2, Proposition 4.3). Third, single-audit public methods reuse at zero marginal license fee, preserving +1 saved labor unit across every previously lawful continuation and realizing voluntary exit, empty dispatch despite affordable audit, outside production, paid return, and dual Raw/Ledger verification along one 25-step trace (Theorems 5.1, 6.1). Fourth, public-function obligations persist across handoffs while expired office jurisdiction vanishes permanently, switching net burden obeys an explicit upper bound, common-cut planning is metered by two invoices across six disjoint ticket phases, and dual-mask dual-replay audit under paid auditor rotation leaks zero information about distinct private reserves across all adaptive strategies, exogenous noise laws, and timed network channels while rebuild reconstructs each participant's exact private root successor (Theorems 7.1–7.4). Fifth, local ledger closure never erases cross-boundary external liabilities, exhausted ledgers obey a two-layer zero-budget squeeze, the paid authority frontier expands strictly at constant instantaneous exit capacity, and one periodic basic payment occurrence simultaneously satisfies all six world-safe regeneration conditions at every depth (Theorems 8.1, 9.1, 9.3, Proposition 9.2).

additional_descriptions.description:
现代经济制度同时面对三项彼此纠缠的结构难题：账面收入或形式契约自由常与真实的离岗失能并存；对探索、风险、等待与维护的合理补偿一旦缺乏原发行上界与当期生活门禁，便经由转让和展期沉淀为支配他人未来的私人管辖权；而公共协调又一再摇摆于失责的主权吸收汇与穿透私人自主的全景审查之间。本文提出并严格证明一部面向可能性持续生成时代的经济宪法。其规范核心在于将基础参与资格、已认贡献索偿、稀缺资源请求与可撤治理权限拆分为四项各自独立说明理由、禁止跨类自动晋升的宪制关系，并以权力携证取代要求个体自证清白的全景监控：凡动用公共预算或限制他人可行域的机构，必须先提交不越权、不转嫁未结责任且不泄漏私人储备的可核验证据。

本文以严格守恒与有根过程模型给出十八项具名形式结果与配对反例。定理 1.2 综合各分域构造，周期再生的六项条件由同一次实际付款上的 Lean 证明联结。第一，真实退出容量等价于五门二分匹配规模；单删捕获、付款或服务通路门禁产生同值的“三个零”，同正容量 K = 1 仍可掩盖关键健康槽缺失（“两个一”），粗观测 (0, ∅) 下的 2 × 2 对角修复矩阵令任何后处理处方至少误修一侧，且原始退出需求满足精确守恒 K + Dmax⁽ᵒʳⁱᵍ⁾ = |Cact|（全捕获下全部原需求留作精确赤字，单纯更换价格观察器绝不改变容量或赤字），而角色外生命周期同时排除四类报复重编码并将旧主体换壳再现严格判为同债继承而非免责新生（定理 2.1–2.2、命题 2.3、定理 3.1）。第二，开放事件机制在不预设封闭状态菜单的前提下受理两轮菜单外实付创新并强制执行当期生活续期门（定理 4.1）；原发行唯一身份令任意转让与阶段迁移下的全槽累计受领恒满足 0 ≤ Ro(r) ≤ Qo，阻断一切无界榨取序列，而撤除端口私人准入特权恰构成五面无资本的充要条件（定理 4.2、命题 4.3）。第三，公开方法经单次实付审计后零边际复用，在保持全部旧合法延续的前提下释放精确劳动与燃料维护红利，并在同一 25 步生产轨迹上同时实现自愿退出、审计付得起条件下的零强制派工、角色外生产与双路独立核验（定理 5.1、6.1）。第四，公共职能责任跨更替连续而到期公职管辖权永久归零，机构可替换净负担受显式上界约束，公共规划由共同切口上的两张实付发票与六阶段互斥票据槽内生计费，限域双掩码双核验在审计轮换下对不同私人储备实现自适应策略、外生噪声与公开时序通道零泄漏，并由 rebuild 精确还原各参与方自有私域根后继（定理 7.1–7.4）。第五，本地平账绝不擦除跨界外部责任，耗尽账本服从零预算两层夹逼闭包，恒定瞬时容量下已付权威前沿严格扩张，且同一次周期基础付款同时满足同谱系修法、退出不收缩、捕获核逃逸、无不可见残差承担者、无终态封死与跨界源属结算六项世界安全再生条件（定理 8.1、9.1、9.3，命题 9.2）。

Third edition. Adds the eighteen-result proof correspondence, the finite independent observation theorem, and the actual periodic successor and external liability proofs. Includes six bilingual figure plates and fifty primary literature references. Paper text and figures are CC BY 4.0. Code and formalization are Apache-2.0.
